name: get_season
title: Sesongen
description: The athlete's active training plan: its target event (if any) and, for every plan week, its phase and each training track's weekly target, planned and actual volume in the track's own unit (km, hours, TSS or sets). plan is null when the athlete has no active plan. Every number is a Reading; never treat unavailable as zero.

name: get_session
title: Én økt
description: One training session: planned against actual, the prescribed workout, where the recording came from, the athlete-reported RPE and their own session log. Every number is a Reading: either available with its value, or unavailable with a reason; never treat an unavailable reading as zero.

anyOf.description: The prescribed intensity. min and max are in the unit of kind: rpe 1-10; hrBpm beats per minute; power watts; pace seconds per km; lactate mmol/L; hrPct and powerPct percent of the threshold named by of (max, lthr; ftp, map, cp); pacePct percent of threshold speed; racePace percent of race speed at the distance named by of. A null bound was not authored.

name: get_session_vs_plan
title: Økta mot planen
description: How one training session went against its plan: TSS, duration (seconds) and distance (metres) planned against actual, the adherence band, whether the recorded interval structure matched the prescription, and the change since the last session of the same kind. Quote unavailable readings by their reason, never as zero.

name: get_today
title: I dag
description: The athlete's day: today's planned and recorded sessions, current fitness (CTL), fatigue (ATL) and form (TSB), this training week's target, planned and actual volume per training track in the track's own unit, and how many week-change proposals wait for the athlete's answer. Every number is a Reading: available with a value, or unavailable with a reason; never treat unavailable as zero.

name: get_training_load
title: Belastning og form
description: The athlete's training load over the last 1–26 weeks: per day the TSS and the fitness (CTL), fatigue (ATL) and form (TSB) after it; per training week the planned and actual TSS and the adherence band; and whether form is trustworthy yet (it needs 42 days of history). Every number is a Reading; never treat unavailable as zero.

name: get_week_change
title: Ukeskiftet
description: The latest week change (Ukeskiftet): the closed week's replan decision and its proposals for the coming week, whether each still waits for the athlete's answer, and whose session each targets. Only the athlete can answer a proposal, in trainm8; each proposal carries the link to where they do. Null when no week has closed with a replan yet.

name: list_sessions
title: Øktene i en periode
description: The athlete's training sessions between two days (YYYY-MM-DD in the athlete's timezone, both inclusive, at most 28 days apart), oldest first, 50 per page. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. Each session has planned and actual duration (seconds), distance (metres) and TSS as Readings.
